title: After an erase from another device, a value page can draw its kept pre-erase chart for under a second until its re-read lands
evidence: From the owner's review of S48 (PR 1682, adversary). ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/RecordStore.swift:39: forgetCharts runs only when erasures moves, and erasures moves only for this phone's own erase. A remote erase lands a new record, so the store's revision moves but the kept histories stay. MetricRead.page (ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/MetricRead.swift:83) then returns .chart(kept) for an open value page until readChart (:126) lands the post-erase read, so pre-erase values can show for under a second. shownChart (RecordStore+Charts.swift:52-53) hides them only while the record predates the erase. Design note first: decide where a landed record whose erase epoch rose drops the kept charts (in land, beside forgetCharts, or by keying histories by epoch), with a test that a remote erase leaves no kept chart drawn. Verify at batch end: an open value page while the website erases. US-25 AC16f
